title: OutputValidationResult
description: Output of the validate_output MCP tool: deterministic checks of the final envelope against the request (category list) and the parsed thread. It corrects only what is unambiguous and reports the rest; it never picks a category by similarity.

valid.description: True when no issue of severity 'error' remains after the safe corrections.

output.description: The envelope with the safe corrections applied (see issues[].corrected). Identical to the input when nothing was corrected.

severity.description: error = the output breaks the contract (e.g. a category not in the list that could not be safely mapped); warning = likely quality problem for human review.

path.description: JSON path of the offending value, e.g. $.classification.categories[1].category

corrected.description: True when the tool fixed it in `output` (exact match after normalising case, whitespace, quotes, dashes and slashes; duplicate removal; human-review flag).
